_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or derived from extracted values by a rule stated beside it.

districts_approached.basis: school districts state officials and Alpha affiliates approached, at least

pilot_districts.basis: districts that launched pilots, at least: Houston, Fort Davis, Aldine

declined_districts.basis: districts that confirmed they were approached and did not pursue an agreement, at least

approached_unnamed.basis: approached districts the reporting names neither as a pilot nor as one that declined, at least this many by the reporting's own floors

board_for.basis: board members the Tribune counts voting the Alpha leaders' charter bid down

board_against.basis: board members the Tribune counts on the other side of that vote

board_seats_voting.basis: members counted in the Tribune's tally, for drawing one seat per member

aldine_students.basis: Aldine students the platform is deployed to, roughly

aldine_campuses.basis: Aldine middle school campuses in the pilot

tea_others.basis: TEA leaders besides the commissioner on the repeat campus visit

tea_party.basis: people in the commissioner's party on that visit, the commissioner and the others

model_hours.basis: hours a day Alpha's full model gives AI to teach basic subjects

day_hours_on_dial.basis: hours on a clock face, the dial the model's hours are drawn on; a property of a clock, never printed

model_dial_degrees.basis: degrees of a twelve hour dial the model's hours sweep, for drawing; never printed

tprep_pass.basis: percent of Texas Preparatory School students who passed, last year

tprep_pass_before.basis: percent at approaches grade level before the partnership

tprep_grade_before.basis: percent at grade level before the partnership

tprep_grade_after.basis: percent at grade level after the partnership

alpha_claim_low.basis: low end of the passing share an Alpha leader claimed, percent

alpha_claim_high.basis: high end of that claimed share, percent

states_rejected.basis: states that rejected Alpha's charter pitch, at least

vote_year.basis: year of the board vote ProPublica places 'last summer' in its report of September 2nd, 2026
vote_year.rule: the report's year - 1, the summer before a September report

tprep_fail.basis: percent who did not pass, for drawing the remainder of a hundred; never printed
